description: Client Quick Add / Create Client form allows submitting with a blank email (no required indicator, submit not blocked).
Client Details edit form allows saving with a blank email and clearing a previously set email.
Client UI email input still shows inline format validation when a non-empty, invalid email is entered.
Server create-client action accepts payload with missing/blank email and persists NULL.
Server update-client action accepts blank email and clears a previously stored email to NULL.
Server actions still reject a supplied-but-malformed client email with a validation error.
REST create/update client schemas accept missing email and validate format when supplied.
ClientSchema read/representation (server/src/lib/schemas/client.schema.ts) tolerates null/absent email so reading an email-less client does not throw.
OpenAPI spec (ce/ee) documents client email as optional and stays consistent with schemas; generated SDK/types build clean.
Blank/whitespace/null client email are all normalized to 'not supplied' (NULL), not stored as empty string, consistently across actions and REST.
